name: W. D. Simpson
role: General manager of the Medora stage line
bio: W. D. Simpson, manager of the Medora stage line, traveled between Medora and St. Paul in early 1885. In April 1885 the paper reported that he and Superintendent Smith had been removed.

moments.label: Reported out with the stage line

mentions: W. D. Simpson returned to St. Paul this morning.
W. D. Simpson returned from St. Paul, and S. G. Smith from Bismarck, last evening.
